_comment: Edit this file, not the runner. Every entry is one row of the comparison, and a row
is only worth having if it differs from another row in exactly one thing — that is
what makes a difference between them attributable. The entries below are ordered so
`model` for the vox adapter is a path to a ggml file on this machine. Nothing is
bundled: download from https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp and point at it.
An entry whose model is missing is reported as skipped with that reason, so leaving
the ones you have not downloaded enabled costs nothing but a line in the report.
`quantization` is recorded, never verified. Say what the file is; nothing checks.

engines._why: The control. Production settings, production pipeline — what a meeting does today.
Same model, same decode settings, no Vox segmenter. The difference from the control is the segmenter, and nothing else.
No prompt at all. Against the control this says whether conditioning earns its place; against the next row it separates vocabulary from continuity.
Domain vocabulary, no carry-over from the previous segment.
Is Small simply too expensive for a live clock? Not assumed to be less accurate — measured.
The accuracy ceiling, on the batch profile. A candidate for a final pass, not for the live one.
